Not in the v4.0.15 tree (4.0/stable), so the skip is a no-op there; it exists on the 4.0 branch head and on 4.1 (4.1/edge runs skip it). The open cost is memory for a second controller on one runner, not time (k8s bootstrap 0.5–0.7 min); not tried live (owner question, parked).

- **Known leftovers:** the suite never destroys `multiple-secrets-parallel-k8s-model`, `model-secrets-offer` or `model-secrets-consume`, because upstream relies on `KILL_CONTROLLER=true`. On the reused lab controller that only destroys `test-secrets-k8s`. After a pass, `run.sh` destroys exactly the models in `leftovers.txt`, then the teardown check runs. Without this the run was `fail` (run 38906319543, all 6 tests passed).
- **Note:** the suite runs `microk8s enable ingress` / `rbac` (`|| true`). Its closing `destroy_controller` (with `KILL_CONTROLLER=true`) falls back to `destroy-model` on a reused controller, so the lab controller survives. `test_secrets_cmr` (same-controller cross-model secrets) runs. Secret values must not leak into artifacts: `scrub_hits` must be 0 on a clean run.
- **Teardown check:** after a pass, `scripts/no-models-left.sh` requires every non-controller model of every user (`juju models --all`) to be gone within 10 min, else `fail`. Between iterations (`repeat`) `cleanup-models.sh` destroys every user's models by qualified name. `run.sh` exports `DESTROY_TIMEOUT=5m` (main.sh default 15m) and `TIMEOUT_MIN` keeps 10 min for this check, so a hung destroy scores `fail`, not `error`.
- **No test ran:** `suite.sh` turns a main.sh exit 0 without any `] Success:` line into 3 (`inconclusive`).
- **Expected verdict:** `pass` on a healthy channel.

- **Budget:** `TIMEOUT_MIN=40` per iteration (calibration: `docs/calibration.md`).
